<thought>We need the number of chemically equivalent carbon atoms (unique carbon environments). The best way is to obtain the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which will list the distinct carbon chemical shifts. The count of distinct peaks corresponds to the number of unique carbon environments. We'll call the carbon_nmr_spectra tool to get the spectrum.</thought>
